fixes.action: Remove the user exclusion from the legacy-authentication block policy, or record the excluded account as a documented emergency-access exclusion in the ScubaGear configuration, so legacy authentication is blocked for every account.
Register passkeys for every user and switch the all-user Conditional Access policy to the phishing-resistant MFA authentication strength, in report-only mode first.
Require the phishing-resistant MFA authentication strength for the highly privileged roles in Conditional Access, ahead of the all-user rollout.
Set "Users can register applications" to No, so only administrators register applications.
Restrict user consent so users cannot consent to third-party applications, and send requests through the admin consent workflow that is already configured.
Find the domain whose password policy failed the check and set its user passwords to never expire.
Move privileged tasks off Global Administrator onto finer-grained roles, so privileged users without Global Administrator at least equal the two Global Administrators the baseline's minimum requires.
Convert the permanent active assignments in the six highly privileged roles to PIM-eligible assignments.
Re-provision the four roles assigned outside PIM through PIM, and remove the direct assignments.
Require approval to activate Global Administrator in the PIM role settings, with an approver other than the requester.
Turn on assignment notification e-mail for the six highly privileged roles the run names, sent to a monitored address.
Confirm the licence the risky-agent policy needs (Entra ID P2 plus Microsoft Agent 365 or Microsoft 365 E7), then add a Conditional Access policy that blocks risky AI agents.
Create a DLP policy for the default Power Platform environment that keeps business connectors apart from non-business connectors and blocks the connectors the firm does not use.
Lower SharePoint external sharing from Anyone to Existing guests, or to Only people in your organization.
Set the allowable permission for Anyone links on folders to View.
